transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, I'm Owen. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Owen. I can't get my phone to connect to the wifi any more, it says incorrect password, and everyone else in the house is fine. It's really annoying.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is annoying, when everyone else is online and you're not. Let's sort it out. Can I take your date of birth?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Callum. So your phone says incorrect password for the home wifi, but everyone else in the house connects fine. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is your phone an iPhone or an Android?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, still here. Did the wifi name change recently, or did anyone change the password on the router?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My brother changed something on the router last week, now I think about it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sorry. I can see the wifi password was changed on the twelfth. On your phone, go to wifi, tap the network, choose forget, then connect again with the password on the back of the router.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, forgetting it. Typing the password from the card. Connected!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Can you open a website to make sure it actually loads?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, so your phone is back on the wifi. Anything else, Callum?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, have a good day.
